'''Coovo Mardri''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Artist/Legends|artist]] living during the [[Old Republic era]]. At some point, during a journey, his [[Passenger liner/Legends|passenger liner]] crashed near the [[Shakamm Crater]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aurea]]. He decided to stay on the planet after he discovered [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] in the crater to make objects of outstanding beauty.
